per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Worker-2 rebuilt source-supported activity/toxicity rows from primary results text and Figures 1/2/4. Database-only activity annotations are linked as provenance but not treated as primary rows.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Worker-6 replaced framework-test placeholder notes with source-reviewed mechanism claims: SHa direct virucidal activity, SHa negative immunomodulation evidence, LL-37 host-response potentiation, and [K3]SHa functional antiviral evidence without direct mechanism promotion.
per_layer_decision_rationale.supplementary_material: The packet and OA packages contain no supplementary files or supplementary tables; figure images were inspected and exact values are taken only from source text when reported.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Merged database catalogs provide exact sequences for LL-37, SHa, and [K3]SHa; the primary article identifies names, lengths/MW/modification context, and analog substitution but does not list every exact sequence string.
DBAASP IC50/IC90 REP labels are retained as database labels; final primary rows preserve the source-reported reduction percentages and viral DNA copy values.
supplementary_index.json and supplementary_text.jsonl show no local supplementary assets; no supplement-derived values were fabricated.
SHa virucidal activity is direct-assay supported, but envelope degradation and [K3]SHa mechanism remain unproven.

adjudication_summary: Worker-2/4/6 re-review closed the prior framework-test blocker by recovering source-supported activity/toxicity rows, preserving database sequence/label conflicts with context, and replacing placeholder adjudication with source-reviewed accepted_with_cautions final artifacts.
